items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: You had Lawrence Marrera was playing banjo... And Sonny Henry was playing trombone and I was playing drum. That was Chris Kelly's band.

ctx.x: Remember who was playing? Oh yeah, I can tell you. I can tell you. It just comes to my mind. Mealy Barnes was playing clarinet. You had Lawrence Marrera was playing banjo. Eddie Marrera, his brother, Lawrence's brother was playing bass. And Sonny Henry was playing trombone and I was playing drum. That was Chris Kelly's band.
How did Sonny Henry fit in with the band like that?
